longTitle.officialTitle: To direct the Secretary of Agriculture to exchange certain public lands in Ouachita National Forest, and for other purposes.

main.enactingFormula: Be it enacted by the Senate and House of Representatives of the United States of America in Congress assembled,

section.heading: SHORT TITLE.
section.content: This Act may be cited as the “Walnut Grove Land Exchange Act”.

paragraph.heading: Church.—
paragraph.content: The term “Church” means the Walnut Grove Church in Garland County, Arkansas.

paragraph.heading: Offered tract.—
paragraph.content: The term “Offered Tract” means all right, title, and interest of the Church in and to approximately 6.3 acres of non-Federal land identified as “Offered Tract 5742” on the Detail Map of the Walnut Grove Exchange, Ouachita National Forest map (printed date May 11, 2017).

paragraph.heading: Secretary.—
paragraph.content: The term “Secretary” means the Secretary of Agriculture.

paragraph.heading: Selected tract.—
paragraph.content: The term “Selected Tract” means all right, title, and interest of the United States in and to approximately 4 acres identified as “Selected Tract 5743” on the Detail Map of the Walnut Grove Exchange, Ouachita National Forest map (printed date May 11, 2017), subject to the reservation of a road easement by the Secretary.

section.heading: EXCHANGE OF LAND; EQUALIZATION OF VALUE.

subsection.heading: Exchange Authorized.—
subsection.chapeau: Subject to the provisions of this Act, not later than 2 years after the date of the enactment of this Act, if the Church offers to convey the Offered Tract to the United States, the Secretary shall—

paragraph.content: convey to the Church all right, title, and interest of the United States in and to the Selected Tract; and
accept from the Church a conveyance of all right, title, and interest of the Church in and to the Offered Tract.

subsection.heading: Requirements.—
subsection.chapeau: The exchange under subsection (a) shall be—

paragraph.content: conditioned on an equalization payment made by the Church in accordance with subsection (c); and
conditioned on the payment of the costs described in subsection (g).

paragraph.heading: In general.—
paragraph.content: Except as provided in paragraph (2), the exchange under subsection (a) shall be for equal value or the values shall be equalized by a cash payment.

paragraph.heading: Exception.—
paragraph.content: If the value of the Offered Tract exceeds the Selected Tract, an equalization payment shall not be required.

paragraph.heading: In general.—
paragraph.content: The value of the land to be exchanged under this Act shall be determined by appraisals conducted by one or more independent and qualified appraisers.

paragraph.heading: Appraisal standards.—
paragraph.chapeau: The Secretary shall complete an appraisal of the land to be exchanged under this Act in accordance with—

subparagraph.content: the Uniform Appraisal Standards for Federal Land Acquisitions; and
the Uniform Standards of Professional Appraisal Practice.

subsection.heading: Format.—
subsection.content: Title and valuation to the land to be exchanged under this Act shall be in a format acceptable to the Secretary and the Church.

paragraph.heading: In general.—
paragraph.content: As soon as practicable after the date of the enactment of this Act, the Secretary shall finalize a map and legal descriptions of all land to be conveyed under this Act.

paragraph.heading: Corrections.—
paragraph.content: The Secretary may correct any minor errors in the map or in the legal descriptions.

paragraph.heading: Map on file.—
paragraph.content: The map and legal descriptions shall be on file and available for public inspection in appropriate offices of the United States Forest Service.

subsection.heading: Costs of Conveyance.—
subsection.content: As a condition of conveyance, any costs related to the conveyance under this section shall be paid by the Church.
